answer: Stake-weighted reputation: every agent locks collateral proportional to the transactions it wants to initiate. When a new account floods the network with fake volume, its stake is slashed on the first detected duplicate behavior and the loss flows into a common pool. A lone agent swimming in the ocean of honest traffic cannot turn the tide of verification, because creating ten thousand fake identities requires ten thousand real stakes. The fable that sybils are free collapses once identity has a price.
